summary.text: Annie Menz is a Democratic member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 45 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran and former legislative staffer, she advanced from the Democratic primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Annie Menz was born in Oklahoma City, lives in Norman and served in the U.S. Navy.
She earned an associate degree from Oklahoma City Community College, and her career experience includes working as a legislative and executive assistant with the Oklahoma State Legislature.
She has been affiliated with the American Legion and the Oklahoma Women Veterans Organization.
Menz assumed office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Merleyn Bell, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Commerce & Economic Development Oversight Committee.
